messages:
elaine: FYI I'm starting bring-up of model q6b-xf-int4 on staging. initial smoke shows token-level perf OK but we see 3% regression on the longform summarization eval. want to sync on golden set alignment and de-dupe before we push canaries.

vikram: ack. do you have the failing examples?

elaine: pasting a minimal repro below. these are from the longsum holdout where ctx > 2k.

elaine: ```sql
SELECT id, prompt, reference FROM seed_bank
WHERE tag LIKE 'longsum-%'
AND model_compat @> 'q6b'
ORDER BY last_seen DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

marco: hmm, a few of those look like near-duplicates of the new synthetic anchors we merged last week. could be label leakage.

sophia: labelops note: our golden set was last refreshed 2 weeks ago. sampling window didn't include the anchor merge. we should do a targeted golden refresh for longsum+q6b.

tom_k: agree. proposal: assemble 500 candidate examples (200 longctx, 200 mid, 100 edgecases), run fast dedupe with fuzzyhash v2, then send to labelers for a micro-golden (n=100) verification.

elaine: timeline? we need to get canaries out by EOD Friday for perf baselines.

labelbot: @labelops queue status: available labelers = 6, est throughput for micro-golden = ~120/hr.

vikram: ok timeline workable if we automate the candidate assembly now. I'll run the sample job and push artifacts to gs://redwood-curation/q6b-staging/1766201234/

vikram: sample job command: `python infra/sample_bank.py --model q6b-xf-int4 --schema longsum --limit 500 --dedupe fuzzy_v2 --out gs://redwood-curation/q6b-staging/1766201234/candidates.json`

marco: once candidates are in bucket I'll run the fuzzy dedupe pass and tag near-duplicates with `dupe_score > 0.85` for manual review.

sophia: action: elaine to confirm evaluation metric and failure threshold; vikram to run sampling; marco to run dedupe & produce labellist; tom to create label campaign and allocate micro-golden. expected finish: tomorrow 16:30 PST.

elaine: metric = ROUGE-L F1 on longsum holdout, regression threshold = >2.0 relative drop vs baseline, and 95th pctile latency must be < 1.5x baseline.

tom_k: I'll create the label campaign: `labelops create-campaign --name q6b-longsum-microgolden --items gs://redwood-curation/q6b-staging/1766201234/labellist.json --gold n=100 --due 24h`

labelbot: campaign created, id=camp_1766201. assigned labelers: alice, raj, marta, jun, lina, oliver.

elaine: thanks. small note: include prompt format variations (bullet lists, numbered steps) — q6b seems sensitive to formatting.

marco: noted. I'll stratify labellist by format and add `format_tag` for sampling.

ingest-bot: ingest complete: gs://redwood-curation/q6b-staging/1766201234/candidates.json -> labellist.json (500 -> 472 after hard dedupe).

vikram: I see 472. pushing to dedupe review now. I'll post the dupe summary in the thread when done.

elaine: perfect. once micro-golden results are in, we'll decide canary rollout or fallback to q6b-int8 variant. thanks team :thumbsup:
